summary: Participants note that implementations already default to 1 MB pages and suggest replacing the absolute recommendation with a trade‑off explanation or bandwidth guidance. It records the message format and schema location without decoding the bytes, allowing engines to preserve original data for audit or regulated use. Participants recommend adding a Delta mode, renaming the proposal to FastLanes, and deferring interleaving and Unified Transpose Layout to later stages. The proposal introduces a Page-First Data Layout for Parquet, allowing each column to independently decide when to cut pages without being bound to row group boundaries.
